{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to properly handle and validate CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR installation paths.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes CMake installation path handling for distributions that customize libexec paths. On systems like Arch Linux that set CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR to 'lib', installed wrapper builds currently cannot locate internal binaries and fail at runtime."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin.cpp, the multiprocess wrapper executable, and its build integration.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a runtime binary discovery failure in the bitcoin wrapper on platforms with non-standard install paths. According to the PR description, on distributions like Arch Linux, the wrapper 'cannot find internal executables like bitcoind or bitcoin-node, failing immediately with execvp'."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/bitcoin.cpp and adds test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py to test the bitcoin wrapper tool.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes execution failure of the bitcoin wrapper command when installed with custom directory layouts. Without this fix, the wrapper cannot invoke underlying executables on distributions using non-default install directories."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 1,

    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }

categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in to properly handle and validate CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR installation paths.
categories.rationale: Fixes CMake installation path handling for distributions that customize libexec paths. On systems like Arch Linux that set CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR to 'lib', installed wrapper builds currently cannot locate internal binaries and fail at runtime.

categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches src/bitcoin.cpp, the multiprocess wrapper executable, and its build integration.
categories.rationale: Resolves a runtime binary discovery failure in the bitcoin wrapper on platforms with non-standard install paths. According to the PR description, on distributions like Arch Linux, the wrapper 'cannot find internal executables like bitcoind or bitcoin-node, failing immediately with execvp'.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Changes src/bitcoin.cpp and adds test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py to test the bitcoin wrapper tool.
categories.rationale: Fixes execution failure of the bitcoin wrapper command when installed with custom directory layouts. Without this fix, the wrapper cannot invoke underlying executables on distributions using non-default install directories.
